items.title: 去噪多机器人轨迹
items.originalTitle: Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories
items.summary: 基于D4orm动态感知扩散去噪框架，提出解耦规划器、在线滚动时域反馈规划器和分布式规划器；在2D/3D差速与全向机器人上与MPPI及学习式扩散模型方法比较，更快更可靠地找到高质量解，并在十架真实四旋翼、100个仿真机器人和六台地面机器人上验证。
items.abstract: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, lev…
keyFacts: 多机器人轨迹规划因非凸、多模态、高维而计算困难，如何构建可扩展、可靠且适应不同运行需求的扩散去噪规划框架？
以D4orm（基于采样的动态感知扩散-去噪框架）为基础，构建解耦规划器、带反馈控制的在线滚动时域规划器和分布式规划器，并在2D与3D环境用差速驱动与全向机器人评估。
基于D4orm的方法比MPPI等其他基于采样的优化方法以及基于学习扩散模型的方法更快、更可靠地找到高质量解；实现十架真实四旋翼障碍环境零样本部署、100个仿真机器人大规模去冲突和六台地面机器人完全机载分布式长期运行。

items.title: TokenCast：预测LLM代理执行期间的Token消耗
items.originalTitle: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
items.summary: 提出TokenCast，为每个执行片段学习可组合成本表示，记录自身消耗与上下文增长，组合相邻片段得到累计估计并在执行中无需额外LLM调用地更新预测，在SWE-bench Verified上平均累计预测时间32.8毫秒。
items.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. The total consumption of a task is therefore hard to predict before execution and the prediction must be revised as the run unfolds. In this paper, we propose TokenCast, which learns a composable cost representation fo…
keyFacts: 同一任务下LLM代理的token消耗在不同运行间可相差一个数量级以上，如何在执行前预测任务总消耗并在运行过程中持续修正预测？
提出TokenCast，为每个执行片段学习可组合的成本表示，记录该片段自身消耗与引入的上下文增长；组合相邻片段得到累计估计，并随新观测证据刷新预测而不需额外LLM调用。
在SWE-bench Verified上每次运行平均累计预测时间32.8毫秒；在4个任务套件和6个代理模型的96种组合中，相对最强基线平均绝对误差降低14.5%；离线预算控制回放中，在相同轨迹完成度下比固定预算策略平均少用21.3%的token。

items.summary: 针对缺乏系统评估缩放律与最优缩放方案方法论的空白，提出基于语言与视觉语言模型流程的4524和8024个检查点的代理基准ScAn-Bench-LLM与ScAn-Bench-VLM，首次跨数据模态系统评估缩放分析的数据获取与外推方法论。
items.abstract: Recent progress in machine learning is driven by large-scale foundation models, where scaling laws and finding optimal scaling prescriptions for architecture, data, and hyperparameters are key in advancing the state-of-the-art. Therefore, it is surprising that no systematic study evaluates the methodology to obtain scaling laws and prescriptions across different model types. To shed light on this crucial blind spot and facilitate future research, we introduce the surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-…
keyFacts: 不同模型类型下，获取缩放律与最优缩放方案的方法论此前缺乏系统评估，如何填补这一盲点并促进未来研究？
构建基于语言模型与视觉语言模型流程的4524和8024个检查点的代理基准ScAn-Bench-LLM和ScAn-Bench-VLM，并在其上系统评估跨数据模态的缩放分析数据获取与外推方法论。

items.title: 空中记忆：基于多智能体记忆聚合的低空问答
items.originalTitle: Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation
items.summary: 研究低空问答，提出生成式对抗考试GAE以前向仿真评估记忆检索并用考试分数量化记忆质量，进而提出MemCen联合选择无人机和分配发射功率；在CARLA Town04/05静态与动态通信下QA准确率92.4%和84.0%，真实PMAS基准达88.5%。
items.abstract: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality…
keyFacts: 在低空问答中，如何显式度量分布式无人机记忆的价值，并在通信约束下通过无人机选择与功率分配优化记忆质量以提升问答表现？
提出生成式对抗考试GAE，用前向仿真评估记忆检索并以考试分数量化记忆质量；据此构建记忆中心MemCen框架联合选择无人机并分配发射功率，推导噪声受限下的QoM感知带帽注水律，并开发PSO与L2M求解器。
MemCen在CARLA Town04和Town05静态与动态通信条件下分别达到92.4%和84.0%的QA准确率，在真实全景多智能体系统PMAS基准上达到88.5%；无人机到机器狗的演示进一步验证所得记忆对环境理解与导航的实用价值。

items.title: SkillRubric：面向多模态智能体协同演化的执行者指导与评估者评分准则
items.originalTitle: SkillRubric: Co-Evolving Actor Guidance and Evaluator Rubrics for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: 提出SkillRubric，将每项技能表示为对齐的执行者面向指导与评估者面向评分准则，由多模态验证器依据截图和工具输出评估技能目标并给予完成与进展奖励，并通过交替协同演化方案改进指导与准则，多模态智能体基准上取得一致性能提升。
items.abstract: Recent work incorporates reusable skills distilled from past interactions into multimodal agent training, providing procedural guidance for long-horizon planning and tool use. However, policy optimization in these methods remains driven primarily by sparse outcome rewards, providing little supervision for intermediate decisions. Rubric-based rewards address this limitation through explicit intermediate criteria, but reliable rubrics are difficult to construct at scale and often disconnected from the procedure foll…
keyFacts: 多模态智能体训练中，技能提供程序性指导但策略优化仍主要依赖稀疏结果奖励，中间决策监督不足，如何大规模构建可靠且与执行者流程一致的评分准则？
基于结构化技能同时规定如何行动与成功执行应达成什么，提出SkillRubric将每项技能表示为对齐的执行者指导与评估者评分准则；用多模态验证器依据截图与工具输出评估技能定义目标，分配完成与进展奖励，并采用交替协同演化方案：在冻结策略下用配对rollout验证指导修订，在固定指导下离线修订准则。
在多种多模态智能体基准上取得一致的性能提升；受控配对rollout进一步表明，演化后的技能相比先前版本能为规划与工具使用提供更有效的指导。

items.title: KV-streams：面向智能体强化学习的高效压缩
items.originalTitle: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: 智能体LLM长上下文受限于GPU内存，上下文压缩虽能保持内存恒定但需多次预填充、拖慢吞吐。提出即插即用的KV-streams，将KV缓存向前流式传递而非每次压缩后清空，兼容任意压缩策略。在三种压缩策略上实现2.6至5倍墙钟训练加速，且流式KV缓存可作为循环状态携带已退出上下文的信息；在受控设置中仅靠RL即可涌现该行为。
items.abstract: Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. Unfortunately, most compaction strategies rely on prefilling the LLM context many times over, hindering training throughput. To alleviate this bottleneck and enable efficient trainable compaction, we propose KV-streams, a plug-and-play strategy compatible with any compaction str…
keyFacts: 如何在不损害性能的前提下，缓解长上下文智能体LLM训练中上下文压缩导致的多次预填充与吞吐瓶颈？
提出KV-streams即插即用策略，将KV缓存向前流式传递而非在每次压缩后清空，并测试其与三种不同压缩策略的兼容性；在受控设置中考察RL是否足以使流式KV缓存涌现循环状态行为。
KV-streams在三种压缩策略下实现2.6至5倍墙钟训练加速，未见性能受损证据；流式KV缓存可作为循环状态，携带早已从上下文中消失的信息，且在受控设置中仅靠RL即可涌现该行为，与先前工作相反。

items.title: MINT：建模生成式AI对网络流量的影响
items.originalTitle: MINT: Modeling GenAI Impact on Network Traffic
items.summary: 生成式AI成为主流网络负载，但数据包级模拟器缺少基于测量的GenAI流量模型。MINT通过隔离网络命名空间采集管线，从三家LLM提供商、四种模态、云与边缘服务器及有线无线接入点收集客户端轨迹。发现GenAI模态呈现独特的上下行不对称与突发结构；MINT对这些突发区间聚类建模，在ns-3中验证突发时序分布，归一化Wasserstein距离为2–25%，并开源首个测量驱动的数据包级GenAI流量模型。
items.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is becoming a mainstream network workload, yet packet-level simulators lack measure\-ment-driven GenAI traffic models. Currently researchers must approximate GenAI services using traditional sources such as file transfer and video streaming, limiting realistic network evaluation of scheduling and capacity planning. We present MINT, a measurement and modeling framework for GenAI network traffic. Using an isolated net\-work-namespace capture pipeline, we collect client-side traces from three LL…
keyFacts: 如何为数据包级网络模拟提供基于真实测量的生成式AI网络流量模型，以支持调度与容量规划评估？
构建MINT测量与建模框架，使用隔离的网络命名空间捕获管线，采集三家LLM提供商、四种模态、云端和边缘服务器、有线与无线接入点的客户端轨迹，并对突发区间进行聚类建模，在ns-3中验证。
GenAI各模态呈现与传统应用不同的上下行不对称和突发结构；MINT在ns-3中验证经验突发时序分布，归一化Wasserstein距离为2–25%；真实数据包突发比恒定令牌生成器模型变异性显著更大。MINT开源了首个测量驱动的GenAI流量模型。

items.title: MeqMuon：用于LLM预训练的矩阵均衡Muon
items.originalTitle: MeqMuon: Matrix-Equilibrating Muon for LLM Pretraining
items.summary: Muon在LLM预训练中兼具高精度与训练效率，近期工作引入逐行归一化以平衡更新幅度，但仅逐行归一化难以适应更新矩阵中不同的失衡模式。提出矩阵均衡Muon（MeqMuon）优化器，通过可自动适配不同失衡模式的归一化同时平衡行与列幅度，无需人工干预；并省去存储AdamW二阶矩估计，降低优化器状态内存。实验表明其收敛性能优于AdamW、Muon等基线。
items.abstract: The success of large language models (LLMs) has been accompanied by continued growth in model size and pretraining costs. Muon offers high accuracy and training efficiency in LLM pretraining. Recent work introduces row-wise normalization into Muon to balance update magnitudes and improve pretraining performance. However, row-wise normalization alone cannot accommodate different imbalance patterns in update matrices. In this paper, we propose an improved Muon optimizer, called \underline{m}atrix-\underline{eq}uilib…
keyFacts: 如何改进Muon优化器，使其能自动适应更新矩阵中不同的行/列失衡模式，同时降低优化器状态内存？
提出MeqMuon优化器，通过可自动适配不同失衡模式的归一化同时平衡更新矩阵的行与列幅度，并移除对AdamW二阶矩估计的存储；在LLM预训练中与AdamW、Muon及其他基线比较收敛性能。
MeqMuon在LLM预训练中的收敛性能优于AdamW、Muon和其他基线；其归一化可自动适配不同失衡模式而无需人工干预，并因省去AdamW二阶矩估计而降低优化器状态内存。

items.summary: 两轮倒立摆机器人在进行非对称物体操作时会出现严重动态失稳与导航漂移。提出分层控制框架：离板视觉系统跟踪顶部ArUco标记提供高延迟全局航点导航，规避里程计漂移；同时低延迟板载控制回路利用惯性数据与编码器数据抑制主动物理扰动。物理实验中，该双回路方法使自建机器人精确导航、抵御减速带瞬态冲击、适应动态跷跷板坡道，并在窄轮距下安全携带负载而不倾覆。

While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded…

items.title: 蒸馏防御在强化学习后极易被攻破
items.originalTitle: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: 蒸馏攻击通过收集大量前沿模型推理轨迹训练自有模型，低成本复制闭源模型能力。现有防御通常在蒸馏后立即评估，隐含假设攻击者不再继续训练。本文主张更现实的威胁模型包含蒸馏后的强化学习训练：错配的威胁模型会带来虚假安全感，部分蒸馏后有效的防御在后续RL后即被攻破。RL降低了有效蒸馏攻击的门槛，使用当前API易得数据的简单攻击即可获得与提取完整隐藏轨迹的复杂攻击相当的推理提升；任何泄露足够信息以重建近似推理轨迹的蒸馏防御都可能无效。

Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that…

在蒸馏后进一步用强化学习训练攻击者模型的威胁模型下评估现有蒸馏防御；比较使用当前API易得数据的简单攻击与提取完整隐藏轨迹的复杂攻击所获得的推理提升。

items.summary: 门控线性注意力（GLA）各头以单一时间分辨率、固定容量记忆运行，形成表征瓶颈。MS-GLA将注意力头分布于多个时间分辨率，并用可学习输入依赖融合层重组输出。在匹配参数量下，其准确率更高、困惑度更低。

We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which ad…
keyFacts: 固定容量、单一时间分辨率的门控线性注意力是否存在表征瓶颈，多时间分辨率分解能否缓解？
提出多尺度门控线性注意力MS-GLA，将注意力头分配至多个时间分辨率，并用可学习的输入依赖融合层动态重组各头组输出；借鉴多尺度状态空间模型（MS-SSM）原理；在语言建模、召回密集型任务和长上下文泛化上评估。

items.abstract: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile man…
keyFacts: 如何实现连续自运动下空间接地的感知，以及机械臂与底座异构动作的协调控制？
提出MM-ABC基础模型，包含稀疏多级VLM特征、仅训练用的未来分支（世界想象与几何意图监督）和MM-APT（掩码联合注意力与clean-action x预测协调操作与移动流）；在5000+小时、40万+回合、12个数据集、17种本体数据上预训练；实验覆盖EBench、RoboCasa365、ManiSkill-HAB、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和真实世界移动操作。

items.originalTitle: Bounding Retraining Equivalence and the Deletion Floor in Materials Machine Unlearning
items.summary: 材料机器学习中，保留的相近结构可在删除特定记录后仍维持准确预测，使删除后预测误差成为模糊指标。作者定义删除下界，推导出围绕该基准的紧致区间，并发现保留一个相近结构时归一化重训练损失中位数约下降8倍。
items.abstract: In materials machine learning, closely related retained structures can sustain accurate property predictions even after removing a specific record, rendering post-deletion prediction error an ambiguous metric for machine unlearning. To resolve this ambiguity, we define the deletion floor as the expected target loss under a specified retraining procedure at the deleted request. Standard indistinguishability constraints yield a sharp interval bounding an update's target loss around this baseline reference. Theoretic…
keyFacts: 在材料机器学习中，如何用删除下界与重训练等价性刻画机器遗忘，并解决删除后预测误差的模糊性？
定义删除下界为指定重训练过程在删除请求上的期望目标损失；用标准不可区分性约束推导围绕该基准的目标损失紧致区间；理论上给出条件近邻界和精确岭恒等式；实证上进行受控冗余扫描和配对Materials Project研究，并与近似更新及原模型系统比较。
受控冗余扫描显示，删除后保留一个相近结构时，归一化重训练损失中位数约下降8倍；在配对Materials Project研究的两种拟合 regime 中，低下界 regime 在超过50%的共享请求上呈现更大预测变化；比较还解耦了有意的目标抑制与保留的整体模型效用。

keyFacts: 如何在长时程心电时间序列去噪中以线性复杂度实现长程时序建模，并兼顾重建保真度与下游诊断性能？
提出Mamba增强模型，在卷积瓶颈处插入选择性状态空间块，结合局部特征提取与线性复杂度的长程时序建模；在合成和真实数据集上评估重建保真度、噪声鲁棒性、记录长度伸缩性及覆盖40余种病理类的下游诊断分类，并考察两种独立分类器的校准。
模型在合成与真实数据集上取得最高SNR和最低RMSE，Mamba优势随序列长度增加和低SNR情形更明显；在两种独立分类器上，基于Mamba的模型在所有去噪器中取得最佳macro AUROC，并优于其卷积基模型；校准结果更复杂且依赖分类器，仅导联特异的Mamba变体在两个分类器上均同时改善两项校准指标；逐类分析显示Mamba显著改善依赖宽泛上下文波形的ST/T改变诊断。

An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps…

items.originalTitle: Robust Variable-Horizon MPC for Landing a Multirotor UAV on a Moving Platform
items.summary: 多旋翼无人机在移动平台上着陆因欠驱动和目标为非平衡态而困难。本文提出计算高效的鲁棒变时域MPC，在线搜索限制在先前行域邻域，能在有界扰动下保持递归可行，并利用固定鲁棒正不变管实现与行域无关的约束收紧。借助无人机微分平坦性，方法应用于解耦线性化系统，在Raspberry Pi 5上以20 Hz实时运行。仿真表明限制行域搜索大幅降低计算且目标影响有限，Gazebo仿真验证鲁棒性，物理实验实现成功着陆。

items.title: 望远镜语言模型
items.originalTitle: Telescopic Language Models
items.summary: 一个部署的语言模型常需服务多种计算预算，但每个预算点仍需单独训练或压缩。本文训练望远镜语言模型（TLM），一种嵌套容量Transformer，用随机前缀监督加完整锚点。每步随机截断一个容量轴前缀与完整下一词目标一起训练，并做一次全容量前向，使产物在每个深度都是有效语言模型。每步两次前向-反向，无架构改变，推理无额外开销。固定出口套件只占据设计空间一点，仅监督少数固定出口会使其他深度处于随机水平。在200M代理套件上，单次TLM运行在全部二十个层前缀都是有效语言模型，质量-预算曲线下面积比固定出口套件减少43-44%，全容量匹配，每次运行GPU成本低约12%。前缀采样密度是可调旋钮。

items.title: PDMD：面向视频扩散模型的投影分布匹配蒸馏
items.originalTitle: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
items.summary: 现代视频扩散模型需对长时空词元序列进行数十次去噪评估。分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）将函数评估次数（NFE）降至几次，但DMD样本在训练中会退化，出现渐进过饱和和伪影。本文将不稳定归因于评论家误差进入后续学生更新并累积。提出投影分布匹配蒸馏（PDMD），投影掉DMD更新中平行于学生-评论家端点残差的分量。在固定噪声查询下证明该残差是评论家端点误差的无偏估计。高维假设下该投影去除恒定比例评论家误差，仅丢弃可忽略的理想DMD信号。PDMD仅需一行代码改动。

Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD) to filter critic errors. PD…

提出PDMD，投影掉DMD更新中平行于学生-评论家端点残差的分量。在固定噪声查询下证明该残差是评论家端点误差的无偏估计；在高维假设下分析投影去除恒定比例评论家误差。仅需对DMD做一行代码改动，无额外损失、网络、数据、模型前向或多阶段训练。

投影稳定训练并改善样本质量，在DMD退化并出现不自然纹理处有效。使用Wan2.1，PDMD在4 NFE下取得VBench总分83.73，比匹配的DMD高1.03分。在MiniMax-H3联合视频-音频生成上，PDMD取得VideoGen-Eval视觉总分83.17，比最强蒸馏基线高0.41分。在比较的4-NFE模型中，PDMD在全部六项音频指标上性能最佳。定性比较和用户研究在视觉质量、运动和音频质量上偏好PDMD。

items.originalTitle: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning

items.title: DexRoam：从第一视角全身人类演示学习移动双臂灵巧操作
items.originalTitle: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
items.summary: 移动双臂灵巧操作需在单条轨迹中连续协调移动、全身运动与手指级灵巧性，机器人演示数据稀缺。DexRoam从人类演示学习该系统，保持全身运动连续耦合。用仅消费级VR头显与头戴立体相机实现无追踪器采集，再经具身、动作语义和时间三阶段对齐映射到机器人动作空间。实验显示人类演示持续提升策略学习，成功率在GR00T N1.7上从29%升至56%，pi0.5上从32%升至57%。
items.abstract: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human…
keyFacts: 如何从第一视角全身人类演示中学习移动双臂灵巧操作，同时保留细粒度且耦合的全身运动结构？
开发DexRoam系统，使用仅消费级VR头显与头戴立体相机的无追踪器采集系统收集全身人类操作演示，再执行具身、动作语义、时间三阶段显式对齐，将运动映射到机器人动作空间，使人与机器人演示可由标准VLA策略联合学习。
真实世界实验表明，人类演示在不同VLA骨干和训练范式下均持续提升策略学习，将GR00T N1.7平均成功率从29%提高到56%，pi0.5从32%提高到57%，并以一半机器人演示匹配纯机器人训练；消融证实每个对齐阶段都必要。

items.originalTitle: Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control
items.summary: 提出面向动态耦合扰动下复合自适应跟踪控制的表示学习框架，将经典扰动适应控制与近期末层自适应扰动抑制方法联系起来。引入统计上有原则的硬EM流程，其硬E步使用卡尔曼平滑器，辨识潜在演化一致收缩的扰动动力学表示。结合贝叶斯滤波得到具有预测能力和可证指数收敛到有界邻域的复合自适应跟踪控制器。在滑地车辆液晃罐与摆负载上验证，并在耦合Duffing振子上评估鲁棒性。

The framework connects classical disturbance-accommodating control (DAC) to recent last-layer adaptive disturbance-rejection methods. Specifically, we introduce a statistically principled hard expectation-maximization (hard-EM) procedure, with a Kalman smoother in the hard E-step, to identify dynamical representations of disturbance whose latent evolution is uniformly contractive. The lear…
keyFacts: 如何在动态耦合扰动下学习具有一致收缩潜在演化的扰动动力学表示，并用于复合自适应跟踪控制？
提出表示学习框架，引入统计上有原则的硬期望最大化（hard-EM）流程，硬E步使用卡尔曼平滑器，辨识潜在演化一致收缩的扰动动力学表示；结合对学习潜在状态的贝叶斯滤波，形成复合自适应跟踪控制器。
该方法将先前固定衰减的末层自适应方法扩展为可学习的预测性DAC式公式，并具有可证指数收敛到有界邻域；在滑地车辆携带液晃罐与摆负载以及耦合Duffing振子系统中，相比固定衰减表示学习消融、LTI扰动适应基线和基于模型的PD基线，实现准确扰动预测和更好的整体跟踪性能。

items.title: 神经调和测度算子
items.originalTitle: Neural Harmonic Measure Operator
items.summary: 提出神经调和测度算子（NHMO），一种用于变形状区域上椭圆PDE问题的神经求解器。调和测度仅依赖几何而不依赖边界数据，NHMO以基于Transformer的边界核参数化其密度，并由Walk-on-Spheres出口样本监督，使一个训练好的核对同一形状的不同边界值无需重训练。经经典分解扩展到Poisson问题，用辅助网络摊销源引起的修正。在MCB-B 3D变形状Poisson基准的全部五类上优于四个先前基线，并在受控2D测试平台上与主要神经算子基线具有竞争力。
items.abstract: We introduce Neural Harmonic Measure Operator (NHMO), a neural solver for elliptic PDE problems on variable-shape domains. The harmonic measure of a domain is the boundary probability distribution that, integrated against any boundary data, returns the Dirichlet Laplace solution. It depends only on the geometry, not on the boundary data. NHMO parameterizes the density of this measure as a transformer-based boundary kernel supervised by Walk-on-Spheres exit samples, so one trained kernel handles different boundary…
keyFacts: 如何为变形状区域上的椭圆PDE构造一个仅依赖几何、无需针对新边界条件和源项重训练的神经求解器？
提出神经调和测度算子NHMO，将调和测度密度参数化为基于Transformer的边界核，并用Walk-on-Spheres出口样本监督；通过经典分解扩展到Poisson问题，用辅助网络摊销源引起的修正，避免直接评估中发散的体积积分。

items.title: 如何循环MoE：展平专家，解耦注意力
items.originalTitle: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
items.summary: 循环Transformer与稀疏MoE各有优势，但如何循环MoE尚不明确。作者提出Foil：在专家参数与每token计算固定下展平专家层、加倍每层专家数与循环次数，并解耦注意力使每次循环有独立注意力参数。实验显示Foil优于未展平基线，100B token时损失随展平程度单调改善，最展平版本低0.012 nat，注意力解耦带来更均衡自信的路由。
items.abstract: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Fo…
keyFacts: 如何在保持专家参数与每token专家计算量固定的前提下，正确地循环混合专家（MoE）模型以改善专家利用率？
提出Foil：展平专家（专家层减半、每层专家数加倍、循环次数加倍）并解耦注意力（每次循环独立注意力参数，专家与路由器保持共享）；在预训练中进行实验与消融分析。
Foil在20B token时每个模型预训练损失均低于未展平循环基线；100B token时损失随展平程度单调改善，最展平版本在等参数等计算下低0.012 nat，下游准确率持平或更好；解耦注意力在相同形状下产生更均衡、更自信的路由；循环收益与加宽专家层收益相互放大，路由置信度比负载均衡更能反映健康的专家使用。

items.title: 用自适应循环Transformer改进测试时扩展
items.originalTitle: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
items.summary: 循环Transformer在参数效率上有优势，但是否改善测试时扩展尚不清楚。作者通过后训练研究准确率-计算斜率，发现已有循环模型斜率更陡但同等计算下不及非循环基线。据此提出TaH2，通过前瞻深度监督联合后训练骨干与迭代决策器，将额外迭代集中在受益token上。AIME上斜率提升53%，匹配测试计算下超出基线峰值约3.4分。
items.abstract: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation. Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs. However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored. Through post-training looped transformers, we study the accuracy-compute slope, measured as the accuracy gain per doubling of test-time decoding FLOPs. We find that existing looped transf…
keyFacts: 循环Transformer能否随输出变长改善测试时扩展，即提高每倍增测试时解码FLOPs带来的准确率增益？
对循环Transformer进行后训练并测量准确率-计算斜率；提出TaH2，通过前瞻深度监督（使用在线标签指示进一步迭代是否改善预测）联合后训练骨干网络与迭代决策器。
已有循环Transformer的斜率常比非循环基线更陡，但在匹配计算下表现更差，且许多token并不受益于额外迭代。TaH2在AIME基准上把准确率-计算斜率提升53%（2.74对1.79），在匹配测试时计算下超出基线峰值准确率约3.4分；随最大迭代深度增加，已有循环模型趋于平台，而TaH2相对基线的增益从深度2的+2.8分增长到深度8的+3.9分。

items.title: Harness学习实现可泛化的测试时自适应
items.originalTitle: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
items.summary: 语言模型智能体由模型与其harness（组织模型调用、工具使用和信息流的可执行程序）共同定义。作者提出harness learning：训练提议模型利用执行反馈修改求解器的harness，将其形式化为可执行程序上的元学习，harness修订扮演梯度更新角色，提议模型用强化学习以修订后harness的任务表现为奖励训练。测试时无需参数更新即可从反馈中迭代精化harness，并在推理与多跳问答上验证。
items.abstract: A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning, which trains a proposer model to revise a solver's harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playin…
keyFacts: 如何让语言模型智能体在测试时利用任务反馈自适应其harness，并将这种自适应能力泛化到未见任务？
提出harness learning，训练提议模型用执行反馈修订求解器的harness；形式化为可执行程序上的元学习，harness修订对应梯度式权重更新；用强化学习训练提议模型，以修订后harness的任务表现为奖励。
在推理与多跳问答实验中，harness学习提升修订质量，测试时自适应能力可迁移到未见任务；在单次修订上训练的策略能多轮持续改进harness，而基于修订序列训练的效果因设置而异。

items.title: RoboCompiler：闭链机器人的图原生编译，实现一致的建模、控制与仿真
items.originalTitle: RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation
items.summary: 含运动学闭环、耦合执行器与变化接触的机器人需要一致的构型、运动、力与动力学模型，但控制与仿真常各自重建接口。作者提出RoboCompiler，将规范机构图编译为共享机械接口，构造闭合路径与解析残差雅可比，经秩检查延拓与校正组装可行构型；切线提升映射独立速度，配对执行器端口映射保持虚功，约束曲率校正扩展到加速度与投影刚体动力学。
items.abstract: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and…
keyFacts: 如何为含运动学闭环、耦合执行器和变化接触的机器人建立控制与仿真共享一致的建模接口？
提出图原生框架RoboCompiler，从刚体、关节、坐标系、惯量与执行器端口构建闭合路径与解析残差雅可比，经秩检查延拓与校正组装可行构型；切线提升映射独立速度到全身与任务运动，配对执行器端口映射保持虚功，约束曲率校正扩展到加速度与投影刚体动力学；采用循环局部评估、生成雅可比与依赖感知复用。

在Komatsu挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo与六UPS Stewart平台上评估物理闭环与任务诱导约束；高精度约束动力学与独立Pinocchio检验确认机械一致性，MuJoCo与Isaac Sim/PhysX执行展示原生接触下的任务性能与模型复用；Kangaroo上编译使残差与雅可比评估时间减少96.7%，闭环rollout墙钟时间减少66.8%，动力学与控制保持不变。

items.title: 基于离散VLA模型的人形机器人移动操作
items.originalTitle: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
items.summary: 离散动作token的VLA模型已用于机械臂操作，但人形机器人全身动作空间维度更高且异质。作者提出Holo-M，据称首个面向人形移动操作的离散VLA模型，通过扩展语言模型词表加入动作token；设计统一动作分词器，分解为末端执行器、身体、手和运动学四个tokenizer，支持遥操作、自我中心人类视频与仿真数据训练。在SIMPLE基准上取得通用与专用评估最高成功率。
items.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language…

Historically, reward regularization and entropy-based policy regularization are key components of empirically successful methods such as GAIL and LS-IQ, yet their finite-sample benefits remain underexplored. We establish fast rates for jointly regularized AIL in finite-horizon Markov decision processes with gene…

items.originalTitle: Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models
items.summary: 揭示个性化生成通过测试时对齐存在巨大未开发性能空间，其更宜视为候选匹配问题。提出参数高效框架，用百万参数级MLP排序模型复用生成器内部嵌入，在九个数据集三个个性化场景上优于十亿参数通用奖励模型，参数不足0.4%，打分延迟低四个数量级。
items.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather…
keyFacts: 标准对齐范式针对单一用户优化，如何以低开销实现面向多样用户偏好的个性化生成？
先用实证研究揭示测试时对齐的性能空间；提出利用百万参数级多层感知机（MLP）排序模型的参数高效框架，直接复用基础生成器的内部嵌入，并通过扩展训练数据提供细粒度个性化偏好。
个性化排名模型能有效利用所发现的性能空间，在九个数据集、三种个性化生成设置上均优于十亿参数通用奖励模型，参数不足其0.4%，打分延迟低四个数量级，并可引导生成以降低物化N个候选的成本。

items.summary: 提出APPL，将每个策略的结构先验作为组合与技能之间的接口：构造智能体将演示分割为可复用技能并为每个技能提出多个结构先验，分别训练并验证策略；运行时智能体按先验选择并组合策略。在MetaWorld和长程ManiSkill任务上提升分布外技能泛化并实现未见技能组合。
items.abstract: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruc…

提出Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning（APPL）：构造智能体将完整演示分割为可复用技能，为每个技能提出若干结构先验，并对每个先验训练和验证一个策略；运行时智能体依据这些接口在特定先验策略间选择并组合以完成新任务。
在MetaWorld与长程ManiSkill任务上，APPL改善了分布外技能泛化并支持此前未见的技能组合；消融接口信息会显著降低性能。

items.originalTitle: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
items.summary: 提出EdgeVLN，结合量化StreamVLN与轻量因果Transformer LATTE，通过llama.cpp VLN驱动在端侧执行。在全部1839个R2R VLN-CE验证未见回合上评估，LATTE在部署的4比特模型上取得最高58.02%成功率，仅增加0.013秒延迟；仅IQ4 NL适配NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB。
items.abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE)…
keyFacts: 压缩本身无法确定VLN模型是否满足边缘平台的内存、延迟与能耗预算并保持导航行为，如何实现运行时感知的可部署量化VLN？

提出EdgeVLN，将量化StreamVLN模型与Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor（LATTE）——一个通过预测Stop Action验证器排名来改善实时停止的轻量因果Transformer——结合，二者通过自研llama.cpp VLN驱动执行，重构流式上下文并在线剪枝记忆token；对预训练StreamVLN主干在8至2比特权重量化与多种推理运行时下进行表征。
在全部1,839个R2R VLN-CE val-unseen回合上评估六种主干预精度与七种候选停止头：LATTE在部署的4比特模型上取得最高SR 58.02%，超过BF16基线，每导航步仅增加0.013秒延迟；4比特格式SR几乎相同但步能耗因执行路径相差36.8倍；仅IQ4 NL在自研驱动下适配该板，驻留内存11.35 GB，比存储流式BF16快20.8倍、能耗低13.3倍；INT2崩溃。

items.title: 策略鲁棒博弈论多智能体轨迹优化
items.originalTitle: Strategically Robust Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
items.summary: 针对AAM去中心化交通管理，将多智能体避碰建模为动态势博弈，但智能体无法精确执行均衡轨迹。提出策略鲁棒形式，每个智能体防范在每步以有界预算扰动其他智能体控制输入的虚构对手。证明在合理假设下仍为精确动态势博弈，线性动力学下内层对抗问题有准闭式解。八智能体实验显示高碰撞风险下轨迹更鲁棒，低风险几乎不变，运行时间小幅增加。
items.abstract: Aviation authorities worldwide expect Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) traffic management to be decentralized among service providers, requiring AAM flights to autonomously plan trajectories by predicting other flights' control inputs rather than relying on centralized coordination. Game-theoretic approaches that formulate multi-agent collision avoidance as an exact dynamic potential game can efficiently find open-loop equilibria, but they assume that agents exactly follow their equilibrium trajectories---an unrealisti…
keyFacts: 在去中心化先进空中交通管理中，当智能体无法精确执行博弈均衡轨迹时，如何使博弈论多智能体轨迹优化对执行、感知和计算不确定性保持策略鲁棒？
提出策略鲁棒博弈公式：每个智能体防范在每一时间步以有界预算扰动其他智能体控制输入、以最小化该步距离的虚构对手；证明其仍为精确动态势博弈，并为线性动力学推导内层对抗问题的准闭式解；使用对数距离代价开展最多八个智能体的实验。
在关于智能体距离代价和鲁棒水平的合理假设下，策略鲁棒博弈仍是精确动态势博弈，线性动力学下内层对抗问题存在准闭式解从而限制计算开销；八智能体对数距离代价实验表明，策略鲁棒性在高碰撞风险配置下选出更鲁棒的轨迹，低风险轨迹几乎不变，运行时间仅适度增加。

items.title: 面向O波段激光应用的InAs/InAlGaAs/InP量子点优化
items.originalTitle: Optimization of InAs/InAlGaAs/InP quantum dots for O-band laser applications
items.summary: O波段兼具最小色散与低传输损耗，适用于光通信。半导体量子点激光器阈值低、热稳定性高，但长波长量子点发射器在基态与激发态能量间隔不足时易发生热载流子逃逸。本文通过分子束外延优化InP上InAs量子点，提升载流子俘获效率并将发射波长调至O波段。吸收光谱证实基态与激发态间存在显著能量间隔，有效抑制高温热载流子逃逸。
items.abstract: The O-band telecommunication spectral range combines minimal chromatic dispersion with low transmission loss, making it highly suitable for optical communications. Semiconductor telecom lasers utilizing low-dimensional active regions, such as quantum dots, offer low threshold power and high thermal stability. However, long-wavelength quantum dot emitters often suffer from thermal carrier escape through excited states when the energy separation between the ground and excited states is insufficient. Here we demonstr…
keyFacts: 如何通过优化InP衬底上InAs量子点的设计，改善O波段激光有源区中的载流子俘获与限制，从而抑制长波长量子点发射器的热载流子逃逸？
采用分子束外延生长InAs/InAlGaAs/InP量子点，优化设计以提升载流子俘获效率并将发射波长调谐至O波段，并对最终结构进行吸收光谱测量。
吸收光谱确认量子点基态与激发态之间存在显著能量间隔，即使在升高的温度下也能有效抑制热载流子逃逸；这些结果凸显了改善长波长量子点激光器载流子俘获与保持的关键设计。

items.title: 木星极光区质子与电子沉降：基于Juno/JEDI数据的统计比较
items.originalTitle: The precipitation of protons and electrons in Jupiter's auroral regions: a statistical comparison based on Juno/JEDI data
items.summary: 高能电子主导木星极光区能量沉降，质子沿同一磁力线沉降但贡献约束不足。利用Juno/JEDI第3至66圈数据，按JRM33与CON2020磁场模型将足迹分入极区与主发射区，对损失锥内平均微分强度积分得沉降能流。两区中质子能量通量中位数比电子低52至223倍，总质子功率不足电子2%；质子通量广泛分布，主发射区高于极区。质子仅起次要作用，每区预计辐射5至9 GW紫外功率。
items.abstract: Energetic electrons dominate the energy precipitated into Jupiter's auroral regions, but protons precipitate along the same field lines, with a contribution that remains poorly constrained. We statistically compare the precipitating energy flux of protons and electrons in two of Jupiter's auroral sub-regions, the polar (PE) and main (ME) emission regions. We use Juno/JEDI data from PJ3 to PJ66. The magnetic footprint of the spacecraft, computed with the JRM33 and CON2020 field models, is assigned to one of the two…
keyFacts: 在木星极光区的极区发射区和主发射区中，沉降质子与沉降电子的能量通量相比如何，质子对极光能量预算的贡献有多大？
使用Juno/JEDI从PJ3到PJ66的数据；用JRM33和CON2020磁场模型计算航天器磁足迹并归入两个子区域；对损失锥内的平均微分强度积分，得到每个物种的沉降能流。

items.title: P2D——二维多航天器太阳风持续性模型
items.originalTitle: P2D - A Two-Dimensional Multi-Spacecraft Solar Wind Persistence Model
items.summary: 背景太阳风是空间天气预报关键。利用太阳自转与大尺度结构缓变导致的约27天自相关，开发多航天器输入的太阳风持续性模型，输入来自Solar Orbiter、Parker Solar Probe、STEREO-A、STEREO-B与OMNI数据库。模型将原位数据从测量位置沿径向及经度弹道传播，生成太阳风参数二维图。地球视角下速度与密度MAE分别为65.41 km/s和3.51/cm³，高速流峰值命中率50%和48%；当地球与L5间有航天器时表现最佳，速度MAE比基准降低约35%。
items.abstract: The background solar wind is a key component in space weather forecasting, as it contains geoeffective high-speed streams and provides the medium through which coronal mass ejections propagate and evolve in interplanetary space. Due to the solar rotation and the slow evolution of large-scale solar wind structures, solar wind properties exhibit an autocorrelation with a period of roughly 27 days, particularly at solar minimum. We made use of this property to develop a solar wind persistence model with input from mu…
keyFacts: 如何利用太阳风约27天自相关特性与多航天器原位观测，构建可在地球视角及其他日球层位置重建太阳风的二维持续性预报模型？
基于多航天器（Solar Orbiter、Parker Solar Probe、STEREO-A、STEREO-B和OMNI数据库）输入构建太阳风持续性模型，将原位数据从测量位置沿径向弹道传播并按太阳自转率沿经度传播，生成可提取的太阳风参数二维图。
从地球视角看，速度和密度重建的MAE分别为65.41 km/s和3.51/cm³；高速流期间速度与密度峰值命中率分别为50%和48%；当地球与L5点之间有航天器时表现最佳，此时预测太阳风速度的MAE相比基准27天持续性模型降低约35%。

items.title: 面向下肢3D姿态的消费级头部与足部IMU可靠性门控融合
items.originalTitle: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose
items.summary: 稀疏惯性姿态估计可实现无相机动作捕捉，但消费级传感器不可靠。在35条单受试者基准上，配对耳机头IMU与两个智能鞋垫足IMU，显示可靠性问题是通道级的：通道消融发现足部加速度最有信息量（66.6 mm对头部单用79.0 mm），而固件融合的足部姿态是破坏增益的负担。模型学习每路每通道块的信任度，用合成损坏预训练数据上的辅助可靠性目标训练时间门控。通道门控模型在干净数据和各模拟故障下最准，门控抑制原生有偏足部姿态通道并以0.92-0.999 AUROC标记丢包突发。
items.abstract: Sparse inertial pose estimation promises camera-free motion capture from consumer devices, but consumer sensors are unreliable: firmware-fused orientations are biased, mounting varies between sessions, and streams drift or drop out. On a new 35-take single-subject benchmark pairing an earbud head inertial measurement unit (IMU) with two smart-insole foot IMUs (SAM-3D-Body pseudo-ground-truth labels), we show the reliability problem is channel-level: a channel ablation isolates foot acceleration as the most informa…
keyFacts: 在消费级头部与足部IMU稀疏惯性下肢3D姿态估计中，如何让模型学习对每路流的每个通道按可靠性进行门控融合，以应对固件融合偏差、佩戴差异和漂移丢包？
构建含35条单人数据的基准，配对耳机头IMU与两个智能鞋垫足IMU，以SAM-3D-Body伪真值标注；进行通道消融；为每路每通道块设置时间门控，用合成损坏预训练数据上的辅助可靠性目标训练。

通道消融显示足部加速度最有信息量（66.6 mm对头部单用79.0 mm），而固件融合足部姿态破坏增益；通道门控模型在干净数据上最准（69.4 mm对静态83.7、无门控86.6），在每个模拟故障下也最准，门控在无测试时监督下抑制原生有偏足部姿态通道，并以0.92-0.999 AUROC标记丢包突发；预先剔除已知失效通道在足部故障下持平但意外流失效时崩溃（头部丢包92.9对79.3 mm）；微调HMD-Poser在干净数据更准（64.4 mm）且名义漂移下更准，偏差或丢包下无显著配对差异，但最坏退化更大（+16.1对+3.5 mm，单种子）。

items.originalTitle: A temperate sub-Neptune transiting the M4 Dwarf TOI-210 identified by NIRPS and TESS -- Uncovering hidden M-dwarf planetary systems in the near-infrared
items.summary: 结合TESS 40个扇区凌星、LCOGT与ExTrA地面测光及NIRPS径向速度，用贝叶斯框架确认TOI-210 b：温带亚海王星（Teq=368±9 K，质量6.75±1.25 M⊕，半径2.234±0.074 R⊕），密度暗示富挥发分。NIRPS给出至少一颗非凌星内行星的中等证据（Δln Z=5.9），候选信号周期2.15与3.76天。
items.abstract: Super-Earths and sub-Neptunes dominate the exoplanet population, yet their compositions, formation mechanisms, and capability of retaining atmospheres remain poorly understood. M-type stars offer a unique opportunity to investigate these questions, thanks to their favorable planet-to-star radius and mass ratios and the diversity of planetary systems they host. We aim to characterise the planetary system of the M4 dwarf TOI-210, in which TESS during its primary mission identified one transiting exoplanet candidate…
keyFacts: 刻画M4矮星TOI-210（TESS主任务发现P=9.01天凌星候选）的行星系统，并检验是否存在非凌星内行星。
联合多技术观测：TESS 40个扇区凌星、LCOGT与ExTrA地面随访、NIRPS保证时间观测的径向速度，并用贝叶斯框架约束恒星、行星与轨道参数。

确认TOI-210 b为温带亚海王星，Teq=368±9 K，质量6.75±1.25 M⊕，半径2.234±0.074 R⊕；密度表明富挥发分，可为约1%质量分数的H/He大气、至少占质量29%的水储库（2σ下限）或二者混合。NIRPS径向速度显示至少一颗位于TOI-210 b内侧的非凌星行星的中等证据（Δln Z=5.9），定向搜索识别出2.15与3.76天两个开普勒信号，最小质量分别为3.2±0.8和4.4±1.0 M⊕。

items.title: GeoVerse：几何潜空间中的世界一致新视角合成
items.originalTitle: GeoVerse: World-Consistent Novel View Synthesis in Geometric Latent Space
items.summary: GeoVerse在预训练3D基础模型的几何潜空间中生成新视角，并从视频生成模型注入外观先验：提取Wan2.2 VACE多层级特征，经ControlNet式适配器注入，全局空间记忆重投影目标对齐引导以保持跨视角一致。在DL3DV上PSNR比GLD高2.23 dB，在Mip-NeRF360上ATE低32.4%。
items.abstract: Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints. Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation. We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views b…
keyFacts: 如何在稀疏图像的新视角合成中，既忠实重建已观测区域、合理补全未见内容，又保持跨视角的世界一致性。
在预训练3D基础模型的几何潜空间中生成，提取Wan2.2 VACE多层级特征并通过ControlNet式适配器注入几何潜扩散模型，利用全局空间记忆聚合观测与合成内容并重投影目标对齐引导。
在多个数据集上提升了视觉质量与几何一致性，相比GLD在DL3DV上PSNR提高2.23 dB，在Mip-NeRF360上ATE降低32.4%。

items.originalTitle: Fast radio burst - persistent radio source systems III. The relation bewteen PRS luminosity and FRB rotation measure
items.summary: 分析50个已知旋转测度的FRB源（含PRS探测与光度上限），用贝叶斯MCMC联合处理探测与非探测，建模Lν∝ζeγc²R²RM^β。自由β时得R=0.016⁺⁰·¹¹⁵₋₀.₀₁₄ pc（1σ），固定β=1时R=0.008⁺⁰·⁰⁵⁸₋₀.₀₀₇ pc；数据略偏好超线性RM标度，并发现显著内禀弥散。
items.abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio transients of extragalactic origin whose physical origin remains uncertain. A small fraction of FRBs are known to repeat, and some of them are associated with persistent radio sources (PRSs), interpreted as synchrotron-emitting nebulae surrounding the FRB source. In the context of magnetar-based models, the rotation measure (RM) of an FRB is expected to correlate with the spectral luminosity of its associated PRS, providing a probe of the physical properties…
keyFacts: FRB的旋转测度与关联持续射电源光谱光度之间是否存在关系，据此约束PRS星云特征尺度并探讨FRB-PRS系统演化。
分析50个已知RM的FRB源样本（含PRS探测与光谱光度上限），采用联合考虑探测与非探测的贝叶斯MCMC框架，将光度—RM关系建模为Lν∝ζeγc²R²RM^β，约束星云特征尺度R与RM标度指数β。
全样本自由β时R=0.016⁺⁰·¹¹⁵₋₀.₀₁₄ pc（1σ），固定β=1时R=0.008⁺⁰·⁰⁵⁸₋₀.₀₀₇ pc；数据略偏好超线性RM标度，但β在2σ内与1一致。光度—RM关系存在显著内禀弥散，大于此前仅基于确认PRS的估计；解释该弥散支持高效粒子加速和/或星云快速膨胀的演化情景。

items.title: 快速射电暴—持续射电源系统 II. 与邻近FRB 20181030A相关的暗弱PRS？
items.originalTitle: Fast radio burst - persistent radio source systems II. A faint PRS associated with the nearby FRB 20181030A?
items.summary: 用欧洲VLBI网1.7 GHz、20毫角秒分辨率观测PRS候选体20181030A-S1，揭示未分辨射电源，峰值流量280±30 μJy，横向物理尺度R<0.5 pc（68%置信度），光谱光度(9±1)×10²⁵ erg s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹，比确认PRS低约3个量级；其低光度与温和旋转测度符合Lν-RM关系，可用年轻弱磁场磁星风星云解释。
items.abstract: Persistent radio sources (PRSs) are the continuum counterparts of fast radio bursts (FRBs), the latter being extragalactic transients of millisecond duration and Jy-level flux density. An FRB-PRS system is thought to be a flaring magnetar surrounded by an highly magnetized, baryon-loaded nebula. We aim to constrain the size of 20181030A-S1, a new PRS candidate, potentially associated with the repeating FRB 20181030A. The latter is localized with $\sim 1'$ uncertainties in the outskirts of NGC 3252, which is a spir…
keyFacts: 约束可能与重复FRB 20181030A相关的新PRS候选体20181030A-S1的尺寸与性质。
使用欧洲VLBI网在1.7 GHz、20毫角秒角分辨率对PRS候选体进行VLBI观测。

在候选体位置发现未分辨射电源20181030A-S1，确认其在毫角秒尺度上致密；点源位置拟合给出峰值流量280±30 μJy，横向物理尺度R<0.5 pc（68%置信度）；流量换算光谱光度为(9±1)×10²⁵ erg s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹，比确认PRS低约3个量级，使其成为已知最近、最暗的PRS候选体。其低光度与温和旋转测度与确认FRB-PRS系统遵循的Lν-RM关系一致，支持磁星驱动星云的共同物理起源；一个初始弱磁场（B⋆≈10¹⁵ G）且年轻（tage≈15–150年）的磁星所驱动的磁化风星云可解释观测到的光谱光度与RM。

items.summary: 用升级版uGMRT在1.26 GHz、角秒尺度观测24个FRB（9个重复、11个单次），结合文献构建75源扩展样本，目录在10²⁹ erg s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹光度阈上完备。探测到6个FRB场致密射电辐射，其中2个已知PRS、4个新候选。确认PRS发生率f_all=0.06⁺⁰·⁰⁹₋₀.₀₃，含候选则0.14⁺⁰·²²₋₀.₀₈。
items.abstract: We present new $1.26$ GHz observations of 24 fast radio bursts (FRBs; 9 repeaters and 11 one-offs), conducted with the upgraded Giant Meter Wave Radio Telescope (uGMRT) at arc-second angular scale resolution, and combined them with literature data to construct an extended sample of 75 sources with either persistent luminosity measurements or upper limits. Our catalog is complete down to a $10^{29}$ erg s$^{-1}$ Hz$^{-1}$ luminosity threshold, which corresponds to the value of the first-discovered PRS, associated w…
keyFacts: 通过射电搜索构建FRB关联持续射电源的扩展样本，并统计PRS发生率及其在重复与单次FRB两类中的差异。
用升级版巨型米波射电望远镜（uGMRT）在1.26 GHz、角秒尺度对24个FRB（9个重复与11个单次）进行观测，并与文献数据结合构建75源扩展样本。

在6个FRB场探测到致密射电辐射，其中2个为已知PRS、4个为新候选；新候选关联3个新重复FRB和1个看似单次源。目录在10²⁹ erg s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹光度阈上完备（对应首个发现的PRS，即FRB 20121102相关者）。仅考虑确认PRS时f_all=0.06⁺⁰·⁰⁹₋₀.₀₃，包含候选时f_all=0.14⁺⁰·²²₋₀.₀₈。保守情形下未见PRS与FRB类别的偏好关联：重复FRB为f_r=0.14⁺⁰·²⁰₋₀.₀₉，单次源为f_nr≤0.12；包含情形下f_r=0.27⁺⁰·²¹₋₀.₁₄，f_nr=0.03⁺⁰·¹⁴₋₀.₀₂。

items.originalTitle: Impact of Patient Orientation in Single- and Multi-View Camera Environments for AI-based Rehabilitation Monitoring
items.summary: 针对相机放置对康复动作错误检测影响研究不足的问题，提出REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集与可分性度量，分析单相机2D/3D姿态估计及四种多相机策略。发现最优2D视角比常用的0°正面视角提升可分性16.9%，常优于单相机3D估计；双视角组合可再提升至多13.1%。
items.abstract: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel se…
keyFacts: 不同相机放置（患者朝向与视角）如何影响基于RGB姿态估计的康复运动质量评估，尤其是对临床相关动作错误的区分能力？
提出REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集（包含多角度正确与错误康复动作）和新的可分性度量；分析单相机2D与3D姿态估计及四种多相机策略：两个正交2D视角组合、3D三角测量、加权3D融合、基于AI的由两台同步相机训练的transformer姿态估计模型。
最优放置的2D相机相比常用的0°正面视角可将可分性提升16.9%，且常优于单相机3D估计；组合两个视角可进一步将准确率提升至多13.1%。

items.summary: 为应对恒星表面不均匀性对透射光谱的污染，在JWST观测GJ 1214 b期间开展多波段测光与高分辨率光谱监测，应用StarSim反演与UnSPOTTER两种校正框架。两者结果在不确定度内一致，表明该观测发生在恒星污染较低的有利自转相位，残差约15 ppm。
items.abstract: Transmission spectroscopy has emerged as an essential tool for characterising the atmospheres of transiting exoplanets. However, stellar surface inhomogeneities contaminate transmission spectra, posing a major challenge to high-precision observations such as those from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). We develop and apply methods to correct for stellar contamination, improving the accuracy of exoplanet atmospheric characterisation. We obtained coordinated multi-band photometry and high-resolution spectroscop…
keyFacts: 如何校正恒星表面不均匀性对系外行星透射光谱的污染，以提高大气表征精度？
围绕JWST对GJ 1214 b的观测，获取协同多波段测光与高分辨率光谱监测，应用两种框架：(i) StarSim反演，从监测数据推断恒星活动参数并传播为校正；(ii) UnSPOTTER，用StarSim模拟训练的神经网络学习从监测数据到校正的映射。
两种框架在不确定度内一致，表明JWST对GJ 1214的观测发生在低恒星污染的有利自转相位；UnSPOTTER推断的校正可在整个JWST波长范围内约束到约15 ppm，意味着校正后残差同量级。若在活动极大附近观测，预测污染将强烈依赖波长并影响大气反演。

items.title: SN 2025qe：低光度热核爆炸多样性案例研究
items.originalTitle: SN 2025qe: A case study of diversity in low-luminosity thermonuclear explosions
items.summary: 展示SN 2025qe（IC 0529中Iax型超新星）从g'波段极大前10天到后150天的光学测光与光谱观测。其峰值g'绝对星等约-16.16，位于Iax类亮度间隙。半解析模型给出56Ni质量0.02 M☉、抛射物质量0.45 M☉、动能7.0×10^49 erg；含束缚残余的模型更符合晚期红色演化。
items.abstract: We present optical photometric and spectroscopic observations of SN 2025qe, a Type Iax supernova in IC 0529, monitored from $-10$ to $+150$ rest-frame days relative to $g'$-band maximum using the GROWTH-India and the Himalayan Chandra Telescopes. SN 2025qe reaches a peak $g'$-band absolute magnitude of $M_{g'} \approx -16.16 \pm 0.15$ mag, placing it in the sparsely sampled luminosity gap between the brightest and faintest members of the SNe Iax class. The multiband light curves show pronounced wavelength-dependen…
keyFacts: SN 2025qe的观测性质如何，以及何种抛射物结构模型能解释其光度与光谱演化？
使用GROWTH-India和喜马拉雅钱德拉望远镜进行光学测光与光谱监测；对赝热光度曲线做Arnett半解析建模；与钱德拉塞卡质量碳氧白矮星三维纯爆燃模型比较；用TARDIS拟合早期光谱、syn++识别晚期光谱特征，并定性尝试用双组分抛射物结构解释持续红波段流量。

SN 2025qe峰值g'绝对星等约-16.16±0.15，位于Iax类最亮与最暗成员之间稀疏采样的光度间隙；多波段光变曲线晚期呈现明显波长相关增宽，红波段比其他Iax超新星更亮。半解析建模得到56Ni质量0.02 M☉、抛射物质量0.45 M☉、动能7.0×10^49 erg。三维纯爆燃模型再现峰值光度和56Ni产额，但低估缓慢偏红的峰后下降；包含束缚残余能量输入的模型更符合晚期演化，尤其是红波段。

items.originalTitle: Catalogue of Collinear Magnetic Structures in Stoichiometric Materials
items.summary: 注意到MAGNDATA中约半数磁结构为共线，采用自旋空间群预设有共线候选磁结构。对ICSD中72,075个非磁化学计量结构枚举所有对称允许的共线磁结构，得到365,639个；用第一性原理确定21,315个材料中7,824个共线磁体的基态SSG对称性，并结合SSG与磁空间群进行拓扑分类，输出数千个新磁拓扑材料。
items.abstract: Magnetic materials persistently serve as a fertile platform for exploring novel quantum emergent phenom ena and advancing information technologies. Reliably determining their magnetic structures (MSs), which is essential for understanding their emergent quantum properties, usually depends on experiments such as neutron scattering. Here, noting that around half of the MSs in MAGNDATA (a database of experimentally determined MSs) are collinear, we adopt the spin space groups (SSGs) to preset the candidate MSs for a…
keyFacts: 如何系统枚举和确定化学计量比材料中的共线磁结构，并对其进行拓扑分类？
采用自旋空间群（SSG）预设共线候选磁结构；基于230个非磁空间群的极大共线SSG子群，枚举Wyckoff位置上所有共线磁结构；对无机晶体结构数据库（ICSD）中72,075个非磁化学计量结构进行分类；用第一性原理计算确定21,315个选定材料中7,824个共线磁体的基态SSG对称性，并结合SSG与磁空间群进行拓扑分类。

items.originalTitle: A Si-on-SiC Platform for Interfacing with Vanadium Dopants in the Telecom O-Band
items.summary: 提出硅-on-SiC异质光子平台，使硅纳米腔与商用4H-SiC中浅层钒掺杂剂渐逝耦合，在共振激发下高效收集零声子线。在生长态系综中观察到Purcell增强光致发光，微秒尺度瞬态光谱烧孔线宽50 MHz；在稀释注入样品中分离出单个钒中心，单光子发射纯度高，Purcell增强寿命109 ns；905 nm重泵浦恢复电荷态效率95%。

However, efficient photon extraction from the high-refractive-index SiC host remains challenging. Here, we introduce a silicon-on-SiC heterogeneous photonic platform in which silicon nanocavities evanescently couple to shallow vanadium dopants in commercial 4H-SiC, enabling efficient zero-phonon line…

items.title: JWST揭示与伽马射线暴相关的尘埃遮蔽超新星
items.originalTitle: JWST unveils a dust-obscured supernova associated with a gamma-ray burst
items.summary: 为确定GRB 240825A（z=0.659）的起源，分析其爆发后66.5天JWST/NIRSpec观测。通过二维谱逐像素分解和宿主-瞬变联合建模，在尘埃遮蔽（A_V=1.37±0.08 mag）和明亮宿主（M_B=-20.5 AB mag）下识别出类似SN 1998bw的宽谱特征点源，SN占NIRSpec流量约10-15%。光谱消光校正光度与SN 1998bw相当，但依赖宿主扣除和模板假设。宿主为延展、尘埃、恒星形成星系，log(M*/M⊙)=10.12±0.05，SFR=5.88±1.60 M⊙/yr，金属丰度12+log(O/H)=8.87±0.04，高于典型坍缩星GRB宿主。该尘埃遮蔽SN的探测确立了GRB 240825A的大质量恒星起源。
items.abstract: Recent observations have challenged the duration-based classification of gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), making the detection of an associated supernova (SN) or kilonova crucial for conclusively identifying their progenitors. We investigate the origin of GRB 240825A at $z=0.659$, whose prompt emission gave conflicting indications of a merger or collapsar origin and for which no SN was detected in deep ground-based observations. We analyze JWST/NIRSpec observations obtained 66.5 days (40.1 days in the rest frame) after th…
keyFacts: GRB 240825A的起源是并合事件还是坍缩星？其相关超新星能否在尘埃遮蔽下被探测到？
分析爆发后66.5天（静止系40.1天）的JWST/NIRSpec观测，采用二维光谱逐像素分解和宿主与瞬变联合建模；从余辉能谱分布约束视线消光，并通过宽带测光和星云发射线表征宿主。

在GRB位置识别出类SN 1998bw宽谱特征的点源，尽管有尘埃视线（A_V=1.37±0.08 mag，可能存在2175 Å bump）和明亮宿主（M_B=-20.5 AB mag）。SN贡献约10-15% NIRSpec流量，在同期地面光学图像中仅约1%总流量。消光校正光度与SN 1998bw相当，但对宿主扣除和模板假设敏感。宿主为延展、尘埃、恒星形成星系，log(M*/M⊙)=10.12±0.05，SFR=5.88±1.60 M⊙/yr，金属丰度12+log(O/H)=8.87±0.04，高于典型坍缩星GRB宿主。

items.originalTitle: Numerical analysis of electron density and response time delay during solar flares in mid-latitudinal lower ionosphere
items.summary: 通过数值求解电子连续性方程，分析不同太阳天顶角下太阳耀斑对中纬度低电离层电子密度Ne(t)的影响。使用GOES-15卫星X射线观测，选取C、M、X级各一个耀斑计算Ne(t)。发现不同离散纬度上Ne(t)时间剖面不同；在X射线峰值时计算中纬度空间Ne(t)剖面。假设耀斑每天同一时间重复，计算全年每日Ne(t)，发现季节性效应。进一步研究响应时间延迟Δt（X射线入射与Ne(t)变化的时间差），发现Ne(t)和Δt均有强季节性效应，为该工作独特结果。

The quantitative analysis of this phenomenon can be attributed to the solar zenith angle (chi(t)) profile over the ionosphere. We numerically solve the electron continuity equation to obtain the lower ionospheric electron density profile (Ne(t)). The electron production rate (q(t)) is governed by the (i) X-ray profile (phi(t)) of the flare, (ii) chi(t)-values during…

items.findings: 不同离散纬度上低电离层Ne(t)时间剖面不同；中纬度空间Ne(t)剖面在X射线峰值时被计算；假设耀斑每日重复后，发现Ne(t)剖面的季节性效应；响应时间延迟Δt呈现强季节性效应。

items.title: K型矮星黑子猎手：如何利用紫外-红外全色凌星光谱直接表征黑子和光斑性质
items.originalTitle: K-dwarf starspot hunters: how to directly characterize spot and faculae properties with UV-IR panchromatic transit spectra
items.summary: 系外行星透射光谱中，恒星黑子和光斑造成的凌星光源效应会引入系统偏差。将参数化黑子与光斑模型纳入光谱反演是常用解决方案，但受恒星光谱模型精度限制。本文提出结合JWST和哈勃空间望远镜同时观测的策略以进一步约束这些模型，通过合成反演演示如何约束黑子和光斑参数，测试不同模型光谱对反演的影响，并考虑恒星活动变化对叠加凌星以达到信噪比的影响。发现紫外和光学波段是打破恒星污染与行星参数简并的关键。

items.title: 一种最优量子线性系统算法
items.originalTitle: An Optimal Quantum Linear Systems Algorithm
items.summary: 研究量子线性系统问题（QLSP）：给定d-稀疏N×N矩阵A（条件数κ）的查询访问和制备与向量b成比例量子态的能力，目标输出A x=b解x的ε近似量子态。改进先前最佳算法查询复杂度O(κd log(1/ε))和κ√d(κd/ε)^{o(1)}，以及下界Ω(κ log(1/ε))和Ω(κ√d)，证明QLSP复杂度为Θ(κ√d log(1/ε))。还解决Berry和Childs的开放问题，证明任意N×N酉算子可用O(√N)次矩阵元素查询以有界误差实现。
